missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend vitamin E solely for antioxidant interest; review diet, current products, medications and clinical indication.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim high-dose vitamin E prevents chronic disease or slows aging.
Do not infer deficiency from an antioxidant goal.
Do not overlook bleeding risk or anticoagulant interactions.
professional_escalation_conditions: Anticoagulant/antiplatelet use, bleeding disorder, planned surgery, hemorrhagic stroke history or active bleeding.
population_and_context: People interested in antioxidants without a defined indication; high-dose vitamin E is not a generic prevention or anti-aging strategy.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Distinguish food intake from supplemental alpha-tocopherol and review total exposure.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin E fact sheet describes evidence limitations and bleeding risk at high supplemental doses. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
